Company Description Global Welding Training Test Consultancy is an ISO 9001:2015 certified premier talent recruitment firm serving major multinational EPC companies across Oil & Gas, Infrastructure, and Heavy Civil–Industrial and Commercial sectors worldwide. For over 25 years, the organization has supported clients in executing, building, operating, and maintaining mega projects by supplying reliable white- and blue-collar personnel on both direct and third-party hire bases. Global Welding Training Test Consultancy has successfully placed over 100,000 project-based professionals, averaging around 6,000 placements per year, and maintains long-term relationships with its clients. The firm manages a fully automated database of more than 10,000 active profiles of experienced personnel, whose skills and performance are validated through client feedback. This strong track record in staffing and recruitment offers candidates opportunities to work on large-scale projects with reputable international companies.

Role Description The Pipe Fabricator role at Global Welding Training Test Consultancy is a full-time, on-site position based in Bahrain. The Pipe Fabricator will interpret engineering drawings and isometric diagrams, measure and cut pipes to specified dimensions, and perform fit-up and preparation for welding. Day-to-day responsibilities include assembling pipe systems, using hand and power tools, checking alignment and tolerances, and collaborating with welders and supervisors to meet project quality and safety standards. The role also involves inspecting completed work, following site safety procedures, and maintaining tools and equipment in good working condition. The Pipe Fabricator is expected to work effectively within a multicultural site team and meet productivity targets and project deadlines.
q: Strong pipe fabrication skills, including reading and interpreting isometric drawings, spool sheets, and P&IDs, and accurately measuring, cutting, beveling, and fitting pipes.
Practical experience using fabrication tools and equipment such as grinders, cutting machines, pipe bending tools, and measuring instruments (tape measures, levels, squares).
Familiarity with welding processes (e.g., SMAW, GTAW) and ability to work closely with welders to ensure proper joint preparation and fit-up to required tolerances.
Knowledge of industrial safety standards and practices, including proper use of PPE, safe handling of tools and materials, and adherence to site safety procedures.
Experience in oil & gas, industrial, or infrastructure projects, preferably within EPC or large construction environments.
Ability to follow technical instructions, work from detailed drawings, and communicate clearly with supervisors and team members.
Minimum of a vocational certificate or technical training in pipe fabrication, welding, or a related mechanical trade; trade test or certification is an advantage.
